instruction: A single sailboat folded from one crisp sheet of paper, with sharp mountain-and-valley creases forming the angular hull and a triangular billowing sail. The paper shows a gentle gradient from white to sky-blue, and thin shadows settle into every fold line.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Origami Sailboat in a origami style. A single sailboat folded from one crisp sheet of paper, with sharp mountain-and-valley creases forming the angular hull and a triangular billowing sail. The paper shows a gentle gradient from white to sky-blue, and thin shadows settle into every fold line. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
